Name: compile_the_statistics_not_the_trajectory
Title: What Retrieval Cannot Carry: Cross-Episode Location Statistics Compiled From the Bank Beat Retrieved Trajectories on Search-Bound Tasks
Short Hypothesis: A compiled artifact can hold a cross-episode aggregate (object -> receptacle location frequencies) that no set of k retrieved trajectories contains. On ALFWorld's search-bound types (pick-and-place, pick-two, look-at-in-light) a ~300-token, type-agnostic, cached cheatsheet compiled by rule from the expert pool recovers at least the Gate-0 retrieval gain on those types (~+10) over no memory at zero uncached prefill. Its value comes from aggregation, not coverage or scaffold: a coverage-matched table built from one sampled trajectory per object class loses most of it, a row-deranged table loses all of it, and the raw 80-item bank in context does not reproduce it unless the table compiled from those same items is added explicitly. Added to the best static arm (Measurement C's static3), the statistic removes the residual that k=3 retrieval keeps over it on the search-bound types (C: ~+9 there); it is not expected to touch the procedure-bound residual (+20..+27), which is reported as the scope boundary, not claimed.
Related Work: Measurement A on this node shows the retrieval gain is procedure-bound (unseen ~ seen) and smaller on the pick types (+15/+18/-5) than on heat/cool/clean (+39..+55). Measurement C (2026-09-09) finds the best static arm is static3 (3 fixed type-conditioned exemplars, ~430 tokens): static3 - k0 = +12.4, k3 - static3 = +17.2 with the residual concentrated on clean/heat/cool (+20..+27) and only +10..+12 on pick types, +4.8 on look-at (CI including 0); the type-agnostic six-procedure prompt is +9.5 over k0 and -20.1 under k3. No static arm in A or C carries anything a single trajectory cannot. Strategy graphs (2511.07800), verifier-promoted skill graphs (2512.23760), tutorials (2606.03951) and ICAL insight exemplars (2406.14596) compile trajectories but never at matched tokens against raw retrieval and never separate distillation from aggregation (G1); SkillEvolBench (2605.24117) finds raw reuse often beats distilled skills but its skills are procedures, not statistics. Dynamic Cheatsheet (2504.07952) accumulates insights at test time but never compares against retrieval of the raw episodes or varies the amount of experience compiled. An LLM-free ALFWorld agent (WCCIS 2026, 'Zero-Shot Embodied Decision Making with Structured Prior Knowledge') hand-builds object-location priors and shows they matter for a symbolic controller, but does not compile them from experience, vary aggregation depth, or compare with an LLM reader's retrieval. Object-search work in robotics (2607.00022 PerSim; 2603.05642 SymSearch) uses population-frequency placement priors, confirming the mechanism exists outside the agent-memory literature. Archived: compile_dont_retrieve (6.0) observed the read to be inert; here the compiled artifact is given content retrieval cannot have and that content is manipulated (depth at fixed coverage, derangement, no-experience prior). optimizer_substitutes_for_memory_scaffold (5.22) could not separate scaffold from content; the deranged-table placebo separates them by construction of the arm, not of the outcome.
Abstract: Agent-memory papers compare retrieval with no memory; the cheapest alternative, a fixed prompt compiled once from the same experience, is rarely run, and when compiled artifacts are studied their gain is not attributed. We isolate one thing compilation can do that per-query retrieval structurally cannot: aggregate across episodes. On ALFWorld with Qwen3-32B and the 1,465-item expert pool on this node, we compile by rule a ~300-token cheatsheet of object -> receptacle location frequencies (from the 'take X from Y' step of each trajectory) and place it, type-agnostically, in the instruction slot as a cached static prefix. On the 134 search-bound games (pick-and-place, pick-two, look-at-in-light) at 8 seeds we compare it, within one serving session, with no memory, k=3 retrieval, Measurement C's best static arm (static3), a depth ladder that varies how many trajectories per object class are aggregated at fixed coverage (1, 4, all), a token-matched deranged table, a same-format table written by Qwen3-32B without the bank, the raw 80-item bank in context (11k tokens, cached) with and without the table compiled from those same 80 items, and static3 plus the cheatsheet. Task success is primary; receptacles visited before the target is taken is the process measure; uncached prefill per episode is logged under vLLM prefix caching. The claim: on search-bound types the compiled statistic recovers at least the Gate-0 retrieval gain (~+10) over no memory at zero uncached prefill; most of that value disappears when each row is a single sample and all of it when rows are deranged; the long-context reader does not compute the statistic from the raw items; and added to the best static arm the statistic removes the ~+9 residual that k=3 retains over it on these types, while the +20..+27 procedure-bound residual is outside its scope and reported as such.
Experiments: Bank: expert pool (1,465 trajectories). Compiler (rule, no LLM): from each trajectory take the receptacle of the first successful 'take <obj> from <recep>' action; per object class (~30) emit the top-3 receptacle classes with count and percentage; ~300 tokens; identical for every game and type; placed in the instruction slot as a cached static prefix. Aggregation-depth ladder at fixed coverage (replaces the n-trajectory ladder, whose low rungs confounded coverage with depth): cheatsheet_d samples, for every object class c, min(d, n_c) trajectories containing that class and compiles the row from them; d = 1 (one sample per class, every class covered, ~150 tokens, three uniform draws), d = 4 (one draw, exploratory), d = all (the full table). Placebos: shuffled_all (receptacle lists deranged across object classes, identical tokens and format); LLM-prior (Qwen3-32B fills the same format for the same object classes and receptacle vocabulary from its own knowledge, no bank, generated once, token-matched). Whole bank: 80 expert items (~140 tokens each, ~11k tokens, cached) selected by a stated rule - stratified by task type and, within type, to cover every object class at least twice; fixed order per seed; whole-bank_80 + cheatsheet_80 adds the table compiled from exactly those 80 items (~250 tokens). Cells: cell S = the 134 search-bound games (pick-and-place, pick-two, look-at-in-light; 59 unseen + 75 seen) x 8 seeds = 1,072 paired (game, seed) cells per arm; seeds 1-2 coincide with Measurement C's cells. Confirmatory arms on cell S (12, all run fresh in one serving session so every contrast is paired within-session): k0; k3 retrieval (~430 uncached tokens); static3 (C's best static arm, 3 fixed type-conditioned exemplars, ~430 tokens cached); cheatsheet_all; shuffled_all; LLM-prior; cheatsheet_d1 x 3 draws; static3 + cheatsheet_all (~730 tokens cached); whole-bank_80; whole-bank_80 + cheatsheet_80. Exploratory arms at seeds 1-2 (268 cells, floor +-12): cheatsheet_d4; instr_all + cheatsheet_all (type-agnostic twin of the static3 combo, ~700 tokens); cheatsheet_80 alone; k3 + cheatsheet_all (additivity); and cheatsheet_all on the 140 procedure-bound games x 2 seeds (280 cells) against C's stored k0/static3/k3 cells for the scope boundary. Process measure from step logs: distinct receptacles visited before the target object is taken (episodes with no take scored at all distinct receptacles visited); steps per episode. Cost: uncached and cached prefill tokens per episode (static prefixes cached across the arm under vLLM prefix caching; retrieval prefixes uncached), tokens/s per GPU, episodes/min; accuracy-cost curves over uncached prefill. Arithmetic: 12 confirmatory arms x 1,072 = 12,864 episodes + ~1,350 exploratory = ~14.2k episodes; at the rate assumed in the original plan (548 episodes per ~30 min, ~18 episodes/min across two vLLM replicas on two A100s, workers tuned to the queue) ~13 h, plus ~1 h for the two whole-bank arms decoding against an 11k cached prefix: one overnight run, resumable JSONL under nohup. Order: (1) fresh k0 and k3 (drift check against C's stored seeds 1-2 and positive control; the bootstrap half-width on this pair fixes the floor and the margins before any confirmatory arm); (2) cheatsheet_all (headline); (3) static3, shuffled_all, LLM-prior; (4) the three d=1 draws; (5) static3 + cheatsheet_all; (6) the whole-bank pair, last among confirmatory arms so a budget overrun costs P6 and not the headline; (7) exploratory arms on idle replica time. Pre-registration file (arm list, cells, margins, decision rules, stopping rule) committed before step (2).
Baselines and Ablations: Baseline per the round rule is the best static arm: static3 (C: +12.4 over k0 overall) is re-run on cell S at 8 seeds, and every retrieval number on cell S is reported as k3 (and k7 from C's stored cells at seeds 1-2) minus the best of {static3, cheatsheet_all, static3 + cheatsheet_all}; cheatsheet_all - static3 is reported (does 300 tokens of statistic beat 430 tokens of type-conditioned exemplars on search-bound types). Type conditioning: the cheatsheet is one fixed table for all games and types; static3 is type-conditioned, so its combo has a type-agnostic twin (instr_all + cheatsheet_all). Ablations that attribute the gain: depth at fixed coverage (d = 1 vs all; d = 4 exploratory) - aggregation vs coverage; deranged table - content vs scaffold, with shuffled_all - k0 reported so 'true table helps' is separated from 'wrong table hurts'; LLM-prior table - experience vs pretraining, with the pre-registered covariate of row-level top-1 agreement between the prior and the compiled table; whole-bank_80 with and without its own table - explicit vs implicit aggregation at matched items; k3 + cheatsheet_all - additivity to retrieved procedures (exploratory). The manipulated variable is the artifact (depth, content, source) at fixed format; the search-bound/procedure-bound split is a pre-registered pooled cell, and its contrast (the statistic helps only where search is the bottleneck) is reported from the 2-seed procedure-bound arm as exploratory scope evidence, not claimed.
Falsifiable Predictions: Decision rule for every 'X - Y >= M on cell S' prediction (floor F = +-6 at 1,072 paired cells; F < M throughout): confirmed iff the paired 95% bootstrap CI excludes 0 in the predicted direction and its upper bound is >= M (the predicted size is not excluded); falsified iff the CI upper bound is < M; otherwise inconclusive and counted against the claim. With F < M a true effect of size M is falsified with probability ~2.5% and a true null is confirmed with probability ~2.5%, so 0 and M are separable. M1 = +10 = the Gate-0 retrieval gain pooled on the search-bound types (A: +15 / +18 / -4.8 weighted by game count; recomputed from stored cells and, if larger, replaced by the fresh k3 - k0 on cell S; fixed at pre-registration). M2 = +7 (two-thirds of M1: the majority of the compiled gain). P1 (headline): cheatsheet_all - k0 >= M1 on cell S. Arm: cheatsheet_all vs fresh k0. Falsified if the CI upper bound < M1 - reachable because nothing forces the reader to use a frequency table. P2 (aggregation, not coverage): cheatsheet_all - cheatsheet_d1 (mean of three draws, draws nested in the bootstrap, F ~ +-6) >= M2 on cell S. Arm: the d=1 draws vs cheatsheet_all. Falsified if the CI upper bound < M2 - reachable if one sampled placement per object class already carries the usable content, in which case the table's value is coverage, not aggregation. Between-draw SD reported; the ordering d1 < d4 < all is exploratory and unpowered (d4 at 2 seeds, F +-12). P3 (content, not scaffold): cheatsheet_all - shuffled_all >= M1 on cell S. Arm: shuffled_all. Falsified if the CI upper bound < M1 - reachable if the reader treats the table as a 'search receptacles systematically' scaffold and ignores rows. shuffled_all - k0 is reported with a pre-registered reading: if shuffled - k0 is reliably negative while cheatsheet_all - k0 is not reliably positive, P3 is not counted as support (it would show a wrong table hurts, not that the right one helps). P4 (experience, not pretraining): cheatsheet_all - LLM-prior >= M2 on cell S. Arm: LLM-prior. Falsified if the CI upper bound < M2 - reachable and plausible, since ALFWorld placements are stereotyped; that outcome means a static prompt with no experience recovers the search-bound retrieval gain and is reported as the informative negative; the pre-registered covariate (top-1 agreement between the two tables) says whether a null is redundancy (agreement high) or the reader ignoring content (agreement low, then in tension with P3). P5 (removes the residual on search-bound types): C's measured residual of k3 over the best static arm on these types is R_S ~ +9 (pick types +10..+12, look-at +4.8; exact pooled value fixed at pre-registration from C's per-game cells and re-measured fresh as k3 - static3 at 8 seeds). Prediction: k3 - (static3 + cheatsheet_all) on cell S is removed: confirmed iff the paired 95% CI upper bound < R_S and the point residual <= R_S/2; falsified otherwise (one boundary, no dead band). Arm: static3 + cheatsheet_all (730 tokens, cached, 0 uncached prefill) vs fresh k3 (430 uncached). Falsifier reachable if retrieval carries instance bindings or procedure detail on these types beyond the location statistic. P5 is run only if the fresh R_S exceeds the floor (+6); otherwise it is dropped as unresolvable at this n and the residual is reported. The residual vs k7 (1,010 tokens; C's stored cells at seeds 1-2) and the type-agnostic twin instr_all + cheatsheet_all are reported alongside. P6 (the reader is not an aggregator): (whole-bank_80 + cheatsheet_80) - whole-bank_80 >= M2 on cell S, where cheatsheet_80 is compiled from exactly the 80 items in context, so the information is present in both arms. Arm: the whole-bank pair. Falsified if the CI upper bound < M2 - reachable if the long-context reader extracts the placement statistic from the raw items itself, making the explicit table redundant. cheatsheet_80 alone vs whole-bank_80 is reported (exploratory, 2 seeds); cheatsheet_80 is no longer a rung of the depth ladder, so P2 and P6 no longer share a cell. P7 (process): distinct receptacles visited before the target object is taken, with no-take episodes scored at all distinct receptacles visited (search ran to the step limit; the restricted both-arms-take version is secondary). Predicted paired reduction >= 1.0 under cheatsheet_all vs k0 on cell S; confirmed iff the 95% CI of the reduction lies entirely above 0.5, falsified otherwise (expected half-width ~0.2-0.3 at 1,072 paired episodes, so the rule is decisive). Reachable falsifier: the reader does not act on the table. P8 (positive control and drift gate, run first): fresh k0 and k3 on cell S seeds 1-2 must each reproduce C's stored cells for the same (game, seed) within the 268-cell floor (+-12); a larger difference is serving drift and stops the run before any confirmatory arm. Fresh k3 - k0 on cell S at 8 seeds: >= +7 (0.7 x M1) - proceed as pre-registered; between 0 and +7 with CI excluding 0 - proceed with M1 fixed at +10 (the headline then asks the statistic to beat the retrieval gain outright); CI including 0 - proceed with P1..P4, P6, P7 but drop P5 (no residual to remove; a P5 test would then be entailed by P1). Shared terms are declared: P1, P3, P4 share the cheatsheet_all minuend and are one measurement with three subtrahends; P7 is scored on the same episodes as P1; they are reported as one family, not as independent confirmations.
Measurement and Noise Control: Outcome: task success on paired (game, seed) cells; net = paired difference in points. Floors: the brief's +-8 at 274 x 2 rescaled by sqrt(548/n): cell S at 134 x 8 = 1,072 cells gives +-5.7, stated as +-6; the 268-cell exploratory subsets +-12; the 280-cell procedure-bound arm +-11. The floor is verified, not assumed: the bootstrap (games resampled, seeds and compile draws nested) on the fresh k3 - k0 pair is computed before any confirmatory arm; if its 95% half-width exceeds +-6.5 (game-level heterogeneity dominating), seeds 9-10 are added to every confirmatory arm (1,340 cells, +-5.1, +25% episodes) before unblinding. Permutation test on paired differences as the secondary test. Margins: M1 = +10, M2 = +7, R_S ~ +9, all fixed at pre-registration and all above the floor; margins are measured effect sizes (A's pooled search-bound gain, C's search-bound residual), not the floor. Three-way decision rule stated once in Predictions; inconclusive outcomes are reported and counted against the claim. Multiplicity: the P1/P3/P4 family shares a minuend and is reported jointly; no claim of independence. Token accounting: cheatsheet 300 (cached) vs k3 430 (uncached); static3 + cheatsheet 730 (cached) vs k7 1,010 (uncached); cheatsheet_d1 ~150 (reported; the token difference in P2 is acknowledged and the token-matched placebo is P3); whole-bank 11k cached. Uncached prefill per episode is logged for every arm and success is plotted against it. Pre-registration file with arm list, cells, margins, decision rules, stopping rule and the M1/R_S recomputation committed before the first confirmatory arm; identical games, seeds, decoding and max steps across arms; static prefixes fixed per seed so caching is real, not modelled; all cell-S arms run in one serving session so within-session pairing holds, with C's stored cells used only for the drift gate, k7 and the procedure-bound comparison.
Preprint Collision Check: Q1 (recent, mechanism) 'compiled cheatsheet of object location priors from agent trajectories versus retrieval ALFWorld' --recent: no results (S2+HF). Q1b (recent, mechanism, shorter) 'object location prior LLM agent ALFWorld household' --recent, channel S2+HF: 'Zero-Shot Embodied Decision Making with Structured Prior Knowledge and Adaptive Calibration in ALFWorld' (WCCIS 2026, no arXiv id; LLM-free symbolic agent with hand-built object-location priors and task templates; no compilation from experience, no retrieval arm, no n sweep); 2607.00022 PerSim (household object search with population-frequency priors, robotics); 2605.05413 (procedural context moved to weights); 2602.06459 UcON (habit retrieval for object navigation). None compares a compiled location statistic with retrieved trajectories at matched tokens in an LLM agent. home: Q2 'object receptacle co-occurrence prior household object search semantic prior' (no agent/memory/retrieval/experience/benchmark words), channel S2+HF: 2607.00022, 2606.15476 FARM, 2603.21887 IGV-RRT, 2603.05642 SymSearch (LLM relational knowledge distilled offline into lightweight models for object search) - the mechanism is established in robotics; none is an in-context artifact compared with per-query retrieval. Q3 (closest named method) 'Dynamic Cheatsheet test-time learning adaptive memory', channel S2+HF: 2504.07952 Dynamic Cheatsheet (persistent evolving insight memory; no retrieval-vs-compiled comparison, no experience-size sweep), 2606.05684 AdaMEM, 2511.20857 Evo-Memory. Verdict: no pre-emption; the nearest overlap is the WCCIS 2026 symbolic-agent paper, which motivates rather than tests the claim.
Risk Factors and Limitations: The prior may be commonsense the model already holds (P4 falsifier); reported as an informative negative for the area, with the agreement covariate saying which kind. ALFWorld placements are sampled from generic plausibility, so the compiled statistic is scene-agnostic; environments with scene-specific placements would need a scene key (a different study). Only Qwen3-32B; the reader's use of a frequency table may differ by backbone. The search-bound cell is 134 games, so the 8-seed floor rests on the brief's sqrt rescaling; if game-level heterogeneity dominates, the adaptive seed rule adds 25% episodes and the total grows to ~17 h. The d=1 rungs have fewer tokens than the full table (~150 vs ~300); P2 therefore confounds depth with the number of listed alternatives, which is the content aggregation produces; the token-matched placebo (P3) and the same-format prior (P4) bound that confound. The search-bound/procedure-bound split is a named property, not a manipulated one; the claim's dependence on it is reported from the 2-seed procedure-bound arm as exploratory scope evidence, and the manipulated variable is the artifact. Measurement C's stored cells enter only through the drift gate, k7 and the procedure-bound comparison; if the drift gate fails the study stops rather than mixing sessions. The rule compiler assumes a 'take X from Y' step in every expert trajectory (true by construction; checked). Whole-bank arms decode against an 11k prefix and are the slowest; they are scheduled last among confirmatory arms so a budget overrun costs P6, not the headline. P1, P3 and P4 share a measured minuend and are one family; a single bad cheatsheet_all cell moves all three.
Addresses gap: G1 (the source of any compilation gain - distillation vs weighting vs extra context - is unresolved): the depth ladder at fixed coverage, the deranged table and the no-experience table attribute the gain to aggregation of experience at fixed format; also G3 (whole-bank arm with and without its own compiled statistic at matched items) and G5 (gain vs aggregation depth; cost per episode under caching, accuracy-cost curves over uncached prefill).
Not a restatement of: Prior-result bullet 'Measurement A: gain carried by clean/heat/cool procedures, pick-and-place +15, pick-two +18, look-at -4.8; unseen ~ seen, so the retrieved value is the type's procedure': this idea claims a second kind of value on the search-bound types, a cross-episode statistic that k retrieved trajectories cannot contain, and predicts it recovers retrieval's gain there and removes the residual C leaves over the best static arm on those types. Measurement C bullet 'static3 - k0 = +12.4; k3 - static3 = +17.2': C's static arms are exemplars and procedures; this idea adds a static artifact of a different kind, names the manipulation (adding the statistic) that removes the search-bound part of the +17.2, and states that the procedure-bound part is outside its reach. Digest card arxiv:2511.07800 (strategy graph distilled from trajectories; source of gain unclear): this idea fixes the output format and varies aggregation depth at fixed coverage, deranges the content and removes the experience, so the gain is attributed to aggregation rather than to extra context or distillation.
Changes made: P1 (was unresolvable): floor shrunk below the margin - the search-bound cell is run at 8 seeds (134 games, 1,072 cells, floor +-6) against a margin of +10 (A's measured Gate-0 gain pooled on these types, not +12), with a three-way decision rule under which 0 and +10 are separable (a true +10 is falsified ~2.5% of the time); adaptive seed rule if the bootstrap half-width exceeds +-6.5. P2 (was near_entailed): the n-trajectory ladder (6/20/80/1465), whose low rung confounded coverage with depth, replaced by a depth ladder at fixed coverage (every object class compiled from d = 1, 4, all sampled trajectories); the confirmatory contrast is d = 1 (three draws) vs the full table with margin +7 > floor; the monotone ordering declared exploratory and unpowered. P3: shuffled_all - k0 added with a pre-registered reading that separates 'true table helps' from 'wrong table hurts'. P4: row-level top-1 agreement between the prior and compiled tables pre-registered as a covariate. P5: restated against C's measured residual on the search-bound types (R_S ~ +9, re-measured fresh) instead of an assumed null, as the brief requires; a single decision boundary (CI upper < R_S and point <= R_S/2) closes the dead band; the combo uses C's best static arm (static3) with the type-agnostic twin run as a control; the 'matches k=3 on all types' clause dropped because C's instr_all is -20.1 under k3 and a location statistic cannot carry the +20..+27 procedure residual - the procedure-bound cell is now the stated scope boundary, tested at 2 seeds. P6: reduced to the explicit-vs-implicit aggregation contrast at matched items with cheatsheet_80 compiled from exactly the 80 in-context items and no longer a ladder rung, so P2 and P6 no longer share a cell; the 80-item selection rule is stated. P7: estimand fixed (no-take episodes scored at all receptacles visited; restricted version secondary) and one decision rule (CI above 0.5). P8: explicit consequence in every band (drift stops the run; a small fresh gain keeps M1 = +10; a null fresh gain drops P5 as entailed). Budget: 12 confirmatory arms x 1,072 + ~1,350 exploratory ~ 14.2k episodes ~ 14 h on two A100s, whole-bank arms last so an overrun costs P6 not the headline; the k3 + cheatsheet additivity arm and the d = 4 rung demoted to 2-seed exploratory. Kept sharp: the headline still asks a 300-token cached table to match retrieval's gain on search-bound types at zero uncached prefill; it still predicts that a single-sample table loses most of the gain, a deranged one all of it, and that the raw bank in context does not reproduce it; and instead of a hedged 'closes the gap' it now names the manipulation that removes C's measured search-bound residual over the best static arm. Margins were moved to measured effect sizes, not lowered to the floor.
